findings.evidence: The Statement permits T=0 but still asserts that the tangent S solves an ODE on [0,T]. Under def-vector-valued-derivative-and-integral and def-first-order-ode-initial-value-problem-and-solution, differentiability requires the time to be a limit point of the interval; {0} has none. Proof 1.1 nevertheless identifies the flow with u_0 and treats its tangent as solving the ODE. Require T>0 or state a separate zero-horizon result that concludes only the derivative of the evaluation map.

The Statement includes x=0 in its quantifier and bounds endpoint error by epsilon_abs(x), but def-dyadic-floating-point-format-and-directed-rounding defines epsilon_abs only for nonzero finite x; thus epsilon_abs(0) is undefined. Although rd(0)=ru(0)=0 gives zero actual error, epsilon_abs(0) is not defined in the stated bound. Define epsilon_abs(0)=0 or exempt zero from that clause.
